metric_definition.space: training-standardised observed elements of all selected numeric columns
metric_definition.cvar: exact worst-q probability mass of the uniform per-origin MAE distribution, fractional boundary origin
metric_definition.relative: cell CVaR90 divided by the same domain/H/seed iTransformer cell
metric_definition.main_statistic: equal-weight geometric mean over the 36 domain/H tasks of the seed-averaged relative CVaR90

geometric_mean_undefined: reported as null when any task ratio is non-positive
